description: Delete one library backup file (and its metadata sidecar) from SPOTIFY_MCP_BACKUP_DIR. Irreversible — the library rows in the file cannot be recovered from anywhere else. Destructive and confirmation-gated: dry_run defaults to true, and executing is refused when the client cannot prompt (SPOTIFY_MCP_CONFIRM=never bypasses). Paths outside the backup directory are refused.

dry_run.description: Preview only, and the default: pass dry_run: false to delete the snapshot.

file.description: Backup file name (e.g. backup-2026-01-02-1.json) or a path inside the backup directory

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: delete_backup
